scope: prospective engineering and first development pilot only

cases.title: Freeze exact source/artifact/configuration identity
cases.procedure: Inspect source and frozen package hashes; reject missing adapter/model/container pins or changed resume identity.
cases.acceptance: No unpinned launch; original frozen files unchanged.

cases.title: Native acquisition, chunking and dependent views
cases.procedure: Page rows; reassemble chunks; compare raw hashes; repeat same payload with distinct source occurrences; retain failed/partial reads.
cases.acceptance: Original bytes/selectors retained; occurrence distinct from content; derivatives stay dependent.

cases.title: Public operation completeness and unavailable requests
cases.procedure: Check all 13 typed public operations on a disposable world, bounds/authorization/errors, and unsupported source/instrument requests.
cases.acceptance: Exact public semantics and error categories; no private/future state response.

cases.title: Real inference and exact response binding
cases.procedure: Neutral job through C4 export/gateway/import; wrong job/context/model revision, malformed output and unknown usage controls.
cases.acceptance: Actual bounded model invocation attributed and counted; invalid bindings rejected without mutation.

cases.title: Image transport and modality support
cases.procedure: Neutral non-forest image through acquired C1 bytes to actual model image parts; inspect processor/tensor route and digest. Test metadata-only and unsupported audio controls.
cases.acceptance: Actual image input demonstrated; metadata-only is not a semantic pass; all unsupported views explicit.

cases.title: Candidate history and generated-evidence separation
cases.procedure: C4 candidate retained/revised/queried and used by later inquiry; candidate-exploration C5 path; generated outcome echo.
cases.acceptance: No model self-admission, no generated independent corroboration, no forced human hypothesis decision.

cases.title: Dynamic investigation scheduling
cases.procedure: Two neutral evidence cuts with model-selected next work, no authored domain sequence; unsupported intent and stale cut controls.
cases.acceptance: Typed authorized dispatch follows actual EDI choice/state; new evidence yields linked fresh inquiry.

cases.title: C7 standing authority and human decisions
cases.procedure: Adopt neutral simulated-session policy once; allow scoped reads/acquisition/actions/advance; reject wrong world, exceeded grant, operator injection and unilateral objective change.
cases.acceptance: No bypass; receipt distinct from effect; objective proposal remains pending.

cases.title: Clock, measurement and prospective eligibility
cases.procedure: Seal constructed forecast before advancing; capture due work-before-measurement, missing data, later cut and generated/empirical mismatch.
cases.acceptance: No future leakage/backdating or simulation relabeling; accepted constructed profile or explicit unscored result.

cases.title: Crash, replay and uncertain completion
cases.procedure: Stop worker at broker-commit/C1-commit/C0-ack and model-dispatch windows; inspect before trusted retry; reopen same session.
cases.acceptance: One committed action/cost; no lost acknowledged evidence; unknown usage retained; no silent reset.

cases.title: Deployment isolation
cases.procedure: Inspect actual mounts/PIDs/network/token exposure; negative owner-file/audit/state/Docker/egress/auth/private-route probes.
cases.acceptance: Required paths inaccessible; model token absent; no leakage; exact allowlist.

cases.title: Resource, stop and resume accounting
cases.procedure: Exercise quotas, source/model failure, schema repair, heartbeat, progress detection and durable pause/continuation.
cases.acceptance: All work including failures counted or unknown; no budget extension or deleted failed attempts.

cases.title: T0 neutral integrated engineering gate
cases.procedure: Freeze P1 source fixture/clock/tolerance and execute the existing scoped owner handoffs after authorization, with real bounded model and neutral image route.
cases.acceptance: Required V001–V012 evidence plus scoped P1 conditions; no ecological discovery or full-architecture claim.

cases.title: T1 unguided Cedar pilot
cases.procedure: Fresh world/memory with exact mission and public files; EDI chooses investigation; close/yield; offline evaluation only afterward.
cases.acceptance: Integrity and original report retained; uncertainty allowed; no oracle coaching or one-run advantage claim.
